claims.claim: Fabrinet reported record fiscal Q4 revenue of $1.316B, up 45% year over year, and record FY2026 revenue of $4.6B, up 36%, indicating strong demand and execution in advanced optical/electronic manufacturing.

risks.risk: Rapid growth in outsourced advanced manufacturing can amplify customer/program concentration and capacity-cycle exposure; current source does not quantify those dependencies.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration, program mix and durability of the 45% quarterly growth rate require filing-level follow-up.

claims.claim: Record quarterly and annual revenue materially supports execution capability, but the evidence is insufficient to infer durability or numeric underwriting without customer/mix/capacity detail.

risks.risk: Peak growth can normalize if optical/AI infrastructure programs or major customers change schedules.

unknowns.unknown: No independent evidence in this pass establishes forward capacity utilization or customer diversification.
